propositions: Move GET-rotation stamps from bindings.json into .bridge_state/get_rotation.json to reduce large sort-ordered file size in a later rollout step.
New binaries must write both legacy inline field and sidecar file simultaneously and read max(sidecar, legacy) to maintain compatibility during mixed-version deployments.
Sidecar state is loaded from legacy-only stores in memory and persisted through BindingStore.save() to cover all production save paths without modifying unchanged canonical state byte-stability.
reconcile-check must run with persist=False and never create the sidecar file.
get_rotation.json must be explicitly staged and included in basename membership checks during local reconciliation commits, and documented as a regenerable file in _store/push.py.
Reverting A2-1 is safe because each new-binary pass also advances the legacy inline field, leaving the orphaned sidecar inert.
